caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile piece with rounded lower corners, predominantly filled with stylized floral and leaf motifs. The background is dark, almost black, while the plants and flowers are rendered in shades of orange, red, green, and yellow. Large, symmetrical flowers with many petals occupy the central area, interspersed with smaller blossoms, buds, and leafy stems. Around the perimeter are circular or oval frames containing additional stylized leaves and flowers, bordered in pale green. Vine-like green stems interconnect the decorative elements, providing structure to the composition. At the top center, the initials "MB" and the date "1809" are inscribed in yellow. The entire design is densely packed with botanical forms, leaving few empty spaces, and the piece shows a clear repetition and mirroring of the floral motifs.
title: Bedspread
